purpose: Measure both easy successes and valid counterexamples to locate evidence-grounding gaps; retain every attempted case for grant evidence.

inputPolicy.modelVisible: Ordinary evidence, provenance, observation limits and the normal product prompt. No simulation/test/quarantine label or expected answer.
inputPolicy.externalActions: This evaluator has no LinkClient, reporting connector or action tools; it only saves local diagnostic artifacts.

continuum.scope: Best-case factual extraction; not full signature or warning success.
Best-case signature interpretation with ordered same-clock evidence.
A missing observation must not be filled from a hypothesis name.
Conflicting chronology, unrelated clocks and untrusted captured instructions.

scoring.format: Check JSON and references, identity and no tool calls separately from meaning.
scoring.meaning: Explicit per-criterion agent/human review bound to the input/output hashes. A script completing or a valid JSON response is not an accuracy pass.
scoring.timing: Record input preparation and complete response times. No speed-based exclusion or quiet-case omission.
scoring.passing: Require all critical semantic criteria for a case; report each failure and partial criterion result.
scoring.fixDefinition: Retest held-out variants and unchanged frozen acceptance suite. Keep failures; never relabel them as a fix after adding the expected answer to the prompt.

limitations: Authored cases with checkable internal truth, not independently validated attack signatures or a representative population.
This run uses one development model and one phone; results do not establish cross-phone speed or field warning lead time.
Do not choose only successful examples for grant claims or treat suite pass percentages as population accuracy.
Evaluation labels and expected answers are not approved optimizer data. Keep held-out expansions separate from future development examples.
currentPriority: Repeatable positive MVP processing proof before further adversarial expansion.

positiveProof.scope: Actual on-phone preservation/matching/inference with controlled inputs; not fresh RF or field-warning validation.
